_comment: Pins of flow A1' on ASAP7 (score/ppa.py --pdk asap7): the canonical RTLIL of the pinned flow mapped by a real `abc -liberty` run onto
asap7sc7p5t rev 28, RVT, TT (the four combinational files of ppa_pins_asap7.json), then weighed exactly as A1' is on sky130 (the same
STA, ideal input ramps, no repair, no legality audit, linear extrapolation outside a grid; the asap7 timing setup and constants
policy of ppa_pins_asap7.json). The Yosys script is score/ppa_mapped_asap7.ys (its sha256 is recorded beside this file's). Change
anything here or there and `ppa_mapped_version` must change. A research column, as A1' is on sky130: its fields carry their own
_liberty_sha256_comment: The identity of ppa_pins_asap7.json's set of five files (ppa.py set_sha256: SHA-256 over `<file> <sha256>\n` per file, in the pins' order): both flows weigh with one library.
_abc_liberty_files_comment: The four combinational files, in the order ABC reads them (`-liberty` once each). SIMPLE FIRST: the pinned yosys-abc (ABC 1.01 of 6 May 2025) dies with a segmentation fault when INVBUF is the first -liberty file (MEASURED on a 4-bit adder and mux: INVBUF, SIMPLE, ... and INVBUF, SIMPLE crash; SIMPLE, INVBUF, AO, OA maps).

tools._comment: The builds the asap7 mapped numbers were measured with (score/reference_build.json's rating build); recorded live in every mapped block, never refused.

equivalence._comment: As on sky130: the mapped netlist is simulated against the scored one on `vectors` input vectors through the liberty's own cell functions before it is weighed.
